mentions.name: AI-assisted board game
mentions.description: A board game created with the help of AI, using an n8n pipeline to generate placeholder art and LaTeX (TikZ) for producing all of the game's cards.
mentions.problem: GPT-5 regularly fails at writing and debugging the LaTeX/TikZ code used for card creation, with TikZ often beyond its ability to successfully write or debug.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a boardgame with the help of AI. It's way too easy to create placeholder art with an n8n pipeline, but GPT-5 regularly fails at writing and debugging LaTeX which I'm using for all of the card creation.

evidence.value: I'm working on a boardgame with the help of AI. It's way too easy to create placeholder art with an n8n pipeline, but GPT-5 regularly fails at writing and debugging LaTeX which I'm using for all of the card creation.
